data.gender_notes: Angaazat is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who engages in a battle or struggle, often referring to a warrior or fighter. The name Angaazat carries the meaning “Struggle, Battle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Angaazat usually hope their child will grow to embody struggle, battle and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Angaazat total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: أَنْغَاضَات
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم في اللغة العربية يعني الأمر بذميمة الإصبع. يُستخدم هذا الاسم لتشجيع الأطفال على أداء الصلاة والصوم والخيرات. ويعتبر من أسماء القران الكريم التي تحتفل بالإيمان والتوحيد. وتعود أصول هذا الاسم إلى الفعل «أنغاض» الذي يعني الزجر والتعظيم.

in_urdu.name: انغاضات
in_urdu.long_meaning: اس نام کو اردو میں ہتھیلی دا ذمیم کرنا کے معنی میں پڑھا جاتا ہے. یہ نام چھوٹے بچوں کو نماز، روزہ اور نیکیوں پر مشورہ دیتا ہے. اس نام کی اہمیت اور معانی کا تعلق اسلام کی اصطلاحات سے ہے. اس نام کے پس منظر میں عربي الفاظ کی بنیاد ہے.

in_hindi.name: अंगाझ़त
in_hindi.long_meaning: हिन्दी में यह नाम हाथ में धमकी के अर्थ में आता है। यह नाम बच्चों को नमाज़, रोज़ा और अच्छाईयों के लिए प्रोत्साहित करता है। इस नाम की महत्ता और अर्थ मुस्लिम परंपराओं से जुड़ा हुआ है।

in_pashto.name: انګاضات
in_pashto.long_meaning: د انګاضات نوم پښتو ژبه کې ګوتې ته څخپول کېږي. دا نوم د ماشومانو ته د نماز، روزې او خیراتو د ادا کولو لپاره پریکښونه کوي. دا نوم د اسلامي اصطلاحاتو سره ناستلیکول کېږي. دا نوم د عربي الفاظو په بنسټ جوړ شوی دی.

in_english.name: Angaazat
in_english.long_meaning: The name Angaazat means to remind with the finger. It is used to encourage children to perform prayers and good deeds. This name is significant in Islamic tradition and has a deep meaning. The roots of this name come from the Arabic word 'angaz', which means to rebuke or reprimand.

The name resonates within Muslim communities, evoking images of brave warriors who fought on the battlefield, protecting their lands against invasion or defending their faith against adversity. This name can also be attributed to modern-day individuals who engage in various struggles, such as social, political, or moral, to uphold their beliefs and contribute to the betterment of their communities and the world.

It serves as a reminder that the ultimate battle each individual must face is the battle for their own soul. Through courage, determination, and perseverance, Angaazat can find strength in their relationship with Allah and draw upon His guidance to overcome their challenges, both internal and external. Thus, the name "Angaazat" can symbolically represent the journey of a believer in their pursuit of spiritual growth and understanding of their faith.
